LESSON: HADITH ON KNOWLEDGE

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith
Topic 2.3: Hadith on Knowledge
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Hadith on Knowledge, part of Hadith in Grade 5 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to seek knowledge in Islam? 2. What challenges may hinder one from acquiring education?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. read the Hadith as a source of reference in seeking knowledge,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Hadith on Knowledge in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. assess the importance of seeking knowledge for the benefit of this world and the Hereafter,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Hadith on Knowledge in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. appreciate the teachings of the Hadith by working hard in school.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Hadith on Knowledge in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. read the Hadith as a source of reference in seeking knowledge,

   Hadith on Knowledge helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. assess the importance of seeking knowledge for the benefit of this world and the Hereafter,

   Hadith on Knowledge helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. appreciate the teachings of the Hadith by working hard in school.

   Hadith on Knowledge helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read from a chart/digital devices the Hadith on knowledge: “Seeking knowledge is obligatory upon every Muslim.” (Al-Tirmidhi),

2. search online the importance of seeking knowledge and present it in class,

3. discuss ways of improving academic performance in school,

4. role-play acts on the importance of seeking knowledge in the Muslim society. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read from a chart/digital devices the Hadith on knowledge: “Seeking knowledge is obligatory upon every Muslim.” (Al-Tirmidhi),
2. search online the importance of seeking knowledge and present it in class,
3. discuss ways of improving academic performance in school,
4. role-play acts on the importance of seeking knowledge in the Muslim society. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Hadith on Knowledge together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and problem solving: the skill of interpretation and inference as learners proactively discuss ways of

improving academic performance in their school.

• Digital literacy: the skill of interacting with digital literacy as leaners search online for information on the importance of

seeking knowledge to accomplish the task.

• Creativity and imagination: the skill of networking as learners role-play acts on the importance of seeking knowledge in

the Muslim society.
